Dave Matthews Band

PNC Bank Arts Center - Holmdel, NJ

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > MixPre 10 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: Front House Left of FOH, DFC, Mics PAS @ 11'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 7.18 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Resample 24/48) > Audacity 3.5.1 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Notes:

⁸ Also Sprach Zarathustra and Heartbreaker interpolations

During the encore break, the venue screens displayed an "In Memory of" photograph in tribute to longtime DMB fan Chris Joy, who passed away in 2021.

Huge thanks to the entire DMB organization for supporting live taping.

This recording is dedicated to the memory of Chris Joy and all those whose lives he touched.

Compiled on 2024/07/15.
